svg.title: Rowan's Camp — Rowan’s wagon circle
svg.desc: A supply wagon and fire circle make a welcoming rest stop. Wagon roofs reach a tree shelter; bundles and rope rails connect to the lookout. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: A supply wagon and fire circle make a welcoming rest stop. Wagon roofs reach a tree
shelter; bundles and rope rails connect to the lookout.
